items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith OUT; Saquon Barkley QUESTIONABLE but expected to play vs Cowboys.
items.why: Hamstring for Smith; Saquon expected after practice return.
items.implication: Goedert benefits most; Saquon back in lineups if active vs soft DAL.
items.opportunity: TE/RB targets elevate; Wicks also out

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) downgraded to OUT vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; ruled out Saturday after limited practice week.
items.implication: Huntley start caps Ravens offense; Flowers/Andrews/Likely remain viable but lower ceiling.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) QUESTIONABLE; will test pregame after majority Thursday practice but lacked power/explosion.
items.why: Calf issue; McVay notes no specific play, GTD.
items.implication: If out, Stafford targets funnel to TEs/WRs; hierarchy starts Higbee.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs; expected to play Sunday at Detroit.
items.why: Activated from exempt; facility access noted earlier.
items.implication: Workload TBD post-layoff; backups Lloyd/Johnson poor EPA.
items.opportunity: lead back role if full go

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) QUESTIONABLE for Jets vs Dolphins; key DFS slate uncertainty.
items.why: Quad; game-time lean possible miss or limited.
items.implication: If active start; if out Allen leads vs soft MIA run D.
WR corps decimated; Christian Kirk activated for debut.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans (Achilles/ribs) OUT vs Falcons per Shanahan.
items.implication: Further thins 49ers WR room already missing Deebo.
items.opportunity: Kittle funnel + CMC slot + Kirk debut targets

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/G, 6+ rec and 60+ yards both games since return.
items.why: Caleb Williams return unlocked TE production.
items.implication: Start with confidence as TE1 upside.

items.text: Brian Robinson (hamstring) OUT; 49ers D inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th most); sweet setup for full-workload Bijan Robinson.
items.why: BRob OUT removes vulture; recent RB catches vs SF (White/Holani/Harvey/Love).
items.implication: Bijan RB1 smash spot with volume + TD upside unlocked.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: awesome scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). CMC tempted for more slot with Kaelon Black present despite rare buy on RB-as-WR.
items.why: WR injuries create funnel; CMC smile on slot question.
items.implication: Kittle TE1 lock; CMC receiving upside spike.
items.opportunity: routes/targets/red-zone to Kittle; CMC slot snaps

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps over last three weeks; clear downgrade.
Luther Burden 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR (season-ending knee) reduces 2/3-TE sets giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Kmet to IR confirmed; efficiency elite on limited routes.
items.implication: Increased route share/opportunity in Bears offense.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren (@NO), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB), Bucky Irving (@CAR) for big workloads in friendly matchups; hates Josh Jacobs (layoff), Rome Odunze, Josh Downs, Travis Kelce.
items.why: Volume + matchup for loves; role/matchup issues for hates. Saquon/Breece if active also love.

items.text: A.J. Brown LOVE: 97% routes, 33% target share Week 6 despite drops/inefficiency; buy the usage vs Bears.
items.why: Elite route/target share; Bears soft pass D.
